tone_examples.customer: We just got married yesterday in Kochi! How should we pack and courier our wedding varmala flowers to your Thrissur studio so they don't rot?
tone_examples.reply: Congratulations on your wedding! 💕 Please gently wrap each garland in dry newspaper or paper towels (never use plastic bags or ziplocks, as trapped moisture causes mold). Place them in a sturdy cardboard box and courier via DTDC or Speed Post. As soon as they reach our Thrissur studio, we begin our 7-10 day silica dehydration process to lock in their natural colors!

tone_examples.customer: What are the sizes and prices for wedding varmala flower preservation blocks?
tone_examples.reply: Hello! 🌸 We offer 3 popular preservation sizes: a 6-inch Hexagon or Arch block at ₹2,499, a 9-inch Hexagon or Arch block at ₹4,499, and our luxury 12-inch Statement Block with an integrated warm LED wooden display base at ₹6,999. All include flower dehydration, bubble-free deep casting, and edge polishing!

tone_examples.customer: Can you embed our wedding invitation card along with the garland flowers in the preservation block?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, absolutely! ✨ We frequently embed wedding invitation cards, marriage dates, and couple portraits alongside the preserved flowers. We coat the card with an archival sealant first so the epoxy resin doesn't make the paper translucent. A 9-inch or 12-inch block works best for this.

tone_examples.customer: Do red roses and white jasmine flowers change color when preserved in resin?
tone_examples.reply: Great question! Fresh flowers lose moisture during dehydration: deep red roses become a rich royal burgundy, while pure white jasmine or lilies take on a warm vintage ivory tone. We use premium UV-stabilized resin to ensure they maintain that vibrant preserved look for years without fading.

tone_examples.customer: How long does the entire varmala preservation process take from start to dispatch?
tone_examples.reply: It takes approximately 18 to 21 days in total. The flowers require 7 to 10 days of gentle moisture extraction in silica crystals. Once fully dry, we cast them in 3 to 4 distinct slow-curing resin layers to avoid overheating and bubbling, followed by sanding and high-gloss buffing.

tone_examples.customer: Can you make a matching ring holder cone using leftover petals from our garland?
tone_examples.reply: Yes! 💕 We love creating matching sets. If you order a 9-inch or 12-inch varmala block, we can use the remaining petals to craft a matching ring cone or a pair of floral coasters for ₹450 to ₹650. It makes a beautiful keepsake for your nightstand.

tone_examples.customer: Our wedding was 2 weeks ago and the flowers are already partially dried at home. Can they still be preserved?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, they can! As long as the flowers are free of fungal mold or dark mildew, partially air-dried flowers preserve wonderfully. You can share a clear photo of the flowers on this chat, and our artist will inspect them before you courier them over.

tone_examples.customer: Can we add a warm LED light wooden base to the 9-inch hexagon block?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, definitely! 🌟 We have handcrafted solid wood LED bases with a built-in USB cable and switch. You can add the warm LED base to a 9-inch block for an additional ₹800 (it is already included complimentary with our 12-inch statement block).

tone_examples.customer: Can we preserve bridal chooda bangles or kaleeras inside resin along with the flowers?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, we can! For bridal kaleeras, chooda bangles, or mangalsutras, we recommend our deep 10x10-inch or 12x12-inch deep-cast square blocks (₹5,800 - ₹7,500) which have a 3-inch depth to comfortably encapsulate metallic jewelry without touching the mold edges.

tone_examples.customer: Do you provide a preview or video before dispatching the varmala block?
tone_examples.reply: Always! Once your flowers are dried, we share a dry layout mockup photo showing flower placement for your approval. After final curing and edge polishing, we send a high-definition 360-degree video of your finished piece before you clear the balance payment and we dispatch it.

tone_examples.customer: Can you preserve lotus flowers from a temple wedding?
tone_examples.reply: Yes! Sacred lotus flowers preserve beautifully. Because lotus petals are thick, we dehydrate them petal by petal and reassemble them inside the mold before pouring crystal clear resin. A 9-inch arch block (₹4,499) showcases a full blooming lotus perfectly.

tone_examples.customer: What happens if some flowers fall apart during transit to your studio?
tone_examples.reply: Don't worry! Garlands often shed a few loose petals during shipping. We carefully preserve individual petals and use them to create elegant floating petal borders or aesthetic background cascades around the main flower blooms.

tone_examples.customer: Can you engrave our couple names and wedding date in gold calligraphy on the block?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, we include complimentary gold, silver, or rose gold metallic vinyl calligraphy for couple names and the wedding date on all our preservation blocks! We apply it between resin layers so it never peels off.

tone_examples.customer: Is the preservation block fragile? How do you package it for courier to Bangalore?
tone_examples.reply: Our cured epoxy resin has the clarity of glass but is shatter-resistant like dense acrylic. For courier shipping, each block is wrapped in bubble wrap, encased in 1-inch thick custom-cut thermocol sheets, and packed inside a rigid corrugated box marked fragile.

tone_examples.customer: Do you offer urgent rush dispatch for flower preservation blocks?
tone_examples.reply: Because flower dehydration alone takes 7 to 10 days to prevent rotting, the fastest safe turnaround is 14 days with an express curing slot (₹450 rush fee). We never cut corners on drying, as improper dehydration leads to cloudiness inside the resin.

tone_examples.customer: Can we preserve our baby's hospital birth tag and first floral garland together?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, that's such a precious idea! 👶 We can combine your baby's hospital ID band, birth date plaque, and baby shower floral petals inside a 6x6-inch arched keepsake block for ₹2,900.

tone_examples.customer: What shape is more popular: Hexagon or Cathedral Arch?
tone_examples.reply: Both are gorgeous! The Hexagon block is our modern geometric bestseller and looks stunning on desks and shelves. The Cathedral Arch has a graceful, timeless silhouette that feels like an art piece. Both are priced identically at ₹2,499 for 6-inch and ₹4,499 for 9-inch.

tone_examples.customer: Can you cast gold flakes around the flowers?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, 24k liquid gold leaf flakes or rose gold flakes can be scattered around the flower petals at no extra charge. It gives a luxurious floating stardust appearance when light hits the resin!

tone_examples.customer: Can we ship flowers from outside Kerala, like Mumbai or Delhi?
tone_examples.reply: Yes! We receive bridal flowers from across India via DTDC Express Air or Blue Dart. Just ensure you ship them within 24 to 48 hours of your wedding ceremony so they reach us in fresh condition.

tone_examples.customer: Can you preserve dried petals from a loved one's memorial service?
tone_examples.reply: Yes, we craft memorial preservation blocks with deep care and reverence. We can preserve memorial petals, a small photograph, and a heartfelt quote inside a 6-inch block (₹2,499) or keepsake cube (₹1,800).

tone_examples.customer: How heavy is a 12-inch varmala preservation block?
tone_examples.reply: A 12-inch statement resin block weighs approximately 3.2 to 3.8 kilograms of solid high-density clear resin. It has substantial weight and sits very stably on any mantelpiece or coffee table.

tone_examples.customer: Do you use epoxy resin or polyester resin for flower casting?
tone_examples.reply: We strictly use premium, museum-grade casting epoxy resin imported for artists. It has low exothermic heat (so petals don't burn), maximum UV resistance against yellowing, and zero toxic VOC odors once fully cured.

tone_examples.customer: Can you include a photo inside the varmala block?
tone_examples.reply: Yes! We can place your favorite wedding portrait right in the center, framed by your garland flowers. We laminate the photo with UV protective film so the resin pigments never bleed into the photograph.

tone_examples.customer: Can you preserve orchid flowers from a bridal hair bun?
tone_examples.reply: Yes! Bridal orchids and baby's breath hairpins preserve exceptionally well and retain rich purple, white, and magenta colors. We can craft a tabletop 5x7-inch floral frame for ₹1,050.

tone_examples.customer: What is the booking advance for wedding flower preservation?
